newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro Socialist leader gags mad cow dissidents.
newsitem.headline: Euro Socialist leader gags mad cow dissidents.

text.p: The British leader of the European Parliament's main political group, the Socialists, prevented members expressing dissenting views during a debate on the mad cow crisis, a French deputy said on Tuesday.

"It's very regrettable," said Andre Laignel, a leading member of a special committee of inquiry into the crisis, caused by a public health scare over mad cow disease, or bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE).

Laignel is one of a group of 15 French Socialists who plan to vote on Thursday in favour of a motion presented by Belgian Socialist Jose Happart demanding the immediate dismissal of European Commission President Jacques Santer and his 19 commissioners.

"The Commission was an accomplice to the main culprit - Britain," he said, adding the EU's executive had delayed taking protective measures and had given priority to the beef market over public health.
Pauline Green, British leader of the Socialist group, said the group would join others in tabling a censure motion by November if the Commission hadn't carried out reforms.
"It shows parliament is like Popeye without spinach," he said, adding that like the cartoon character, the assembly liked to show its muscles but lacked the courage to take action.
